column1: # ZAP scan rule overrides — Revelation SRS
# 10016  — Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled
#           Helmet sets X-XSS-Protection: 0 per the modern recommendation
#           (the header was deprecated and its "1; mode=block" value can
#           introduce XSS in older IE versions).  Safe to ignore.
#           No external script includes in the API; ZAP false-positive
#           triggered by the Swagger UI CDN link in the spec.
#           ISO-8601 timestamps are intentional in all API responses.
#           No session cookies are set; JWT is carried in Authorization header.
#           ZAP fires this against the Keycloak redirect; safe to ignore here.
